text:
Alex (AM): FYI — Ken from Helios just signed an LOI. They want a 4-week POC to serve a finetuned Llama-2-derived model over private docs (S3). Need help on catalog fit + onboarding preflight. Main asks: model format support, data isolation (VPC/KMS), and a rough Dedicated pricing ballpark.

Ken (Helios): Thanks Alex — our model is ~13B, finetuned with LoRA, tokenizer is SentencePiece. We'll provide safetensors; sequence lengths ~1024 typical. Main constraint is PII redaction and data never leaving our VPC.

Maya (SE): +1 on VPC + KMS. We'll need customer-managed KMS + restrict egress. For Dedicated we can set up a private subnet. Also confirm: safetensors ok, but need to validate the model topology (hf config) and check kv-cache hooks for LoRA adapters.

Devon (ML Eng): Quick checklist from infra side:
- model file format: safetensors or pt -> both supported but prefer safetensors for speed
- tokenizer: SentencePiece -> need tokenizer.json or tokenizer.model, verify vocab size
- model architecture: decoder-only with standard attention -> run quick compatibility scan for custom attention layers
- quantization plan: do they want int8/4? int8 fast path exists but we must run accuracy regression tests

Priya (Solutions): For presales we typically ask for:
1) security questionnaire (we can pre-fill redacted fields)
2) sample dataset + 50 representative prompts for eval
3) target latency and QPS (SLOs)
4) any regulatory constraints (HIPAA, SOC2 scope)
I'll draft the checklist and the customer email template.

Alex (AM): Can someone estimate how long model validation takes and whether there are known blockers for LoRA + safetensors + SentencePiece? I need to give Ken a timeline and a price bracket for a monthly Dedicated pool (predictable throughput).

Maya (SE): Validation steps + rough times:
- artifact ingest & format parse: 15-60 min
- tokenizer sanity & tokenization scripts run: 30-90 min
- compatibility scan (layer types, custom ops): 1-4 hours
- KV cache integration check with LoRA: 2-6 hours (depends on adapter placement)
- quantization dry-run (int8): 4-8 hours + eval set run
If nothing exotic shows up, full preflight ~1 business day. If custom ops, add 2-3 days.

Devon (ML Eng): Known friction points we've seen:
- custom attention kernels -> needs code changes or fallback to slower kernel
- tokenizer mismatches (special tokens missing) -> breaks chat flows
- LoRA checkpoints stored separately vs merged models -> bridging logic needed
I can run the compatibility tool once Ken drops the artifact. Use this command (internal tool):
```
rw-model-validate --input s3://helios-poc/model/safetensors --tokenizer s3://helios-poc/tokenizer.json --out report.json
```
That produces a summary and a `compat_flags` list.

Alex (AM): Perfect. Ken — if you can upload to the S3 path above and grant the delivery role read access, Devon will kick off the scan and we can aim for the 1 business day target. Also: what's your latency SLO?

Ken (Helios): Target < 200ms p95 for single-turn generation at 8 concurrent QPS. We'll grant access today. Also want an estimated monthly cost for a Dedicated 13B serving pool with that SLO.

Maya (SE): For 13B with p95 <200ms at 8 qps, rough committed pool estimate = 3-4x A100 equivalent GPU hours depending on batching. Ballpark monthly commit range: $XXk–$YYk (I'll refine after we know quantization and batchability). Pricing note: reserved commit discounts apply; we can run a cost sim once we have sequence length stats.

Priya (Solutions): I'll attach the presales checklist + sample security questionnaire in the customer email. Also will ask for a short prompt suite (50) and an eval rubric (top-k/recall/ROUGE or human pass/fail).

Devon (ML Eng): small heads-up: if they want merged LoRA + int4 quant -> we should test for quality regressions. If they insist on aggressive quant, we'll suggest a fallback model variant for high-quality results (e.g., quantized-8 for production, quantized-4 as low-cost).

deploy-bot: Catalog scan job queued — job_id=52318, expected completion ~2h.

Alex (AM): Great — next actions:
- Ken: upload artifact + grant access (Ken)
- Devon: run `rw-model-validate` once access is available (Devon)
- Maya: draft Dedicated SLO->capacity estimate + VPC onboarding checklist (Maya)
- Priya: send presales checklist & security questionnaire template to Ken (Priya)

Ken (Helios): Upload done and IAM role shared. Thanks — please proceed.

Devon (ML Eng): Started validation. Initial report shows tokenizer found, topology standard, LoRA adapters detected but stored separately (we can handle). Two minor flags: special token <|mask|> not in tokenizer vocab, and a custom rotary tapering layer that falls back to slower kernel. I'll post full report when job finishes.

Maya (SE): Noted on rotary tapering — that explains some perf delta. We can still meet 200ms p95 with a small Dedicated footprint but cost will be slightly higher.

Priya (Solutions): Sending checklist now. Ken — quick Q: any contractual restrictions on model uploads for the POC (retention window)? We usually put 30-day auto-delete for customer artifacts in the POC environment unless you request otherwise.

Ken (Helios): 30 days ok. Also we need SOC2 controls documented before kickoff.

Alex (AM): I'll loop in GRC if we need formal SOC2 attestation docs. For now, Priya — include the SOC2 summary in the email.

Devon (ML Eng): Full validation report uploaded: s3://rw-internal-reports/52318-1945678910-report.json — highlights:
- compatibility: PASS (adapter handling required)
- tokenizer: WARN (missing <|mask|> token)
- perf: EXPECT ~220ms p95 unoptimized, ~180ms p95 with int8 + small batching
- quant-note: int8 maintains baseline quality on our eval (delta < 2% on metric), int4 not tested

Alex (AM): Thanks Devon. I'll share the interim numbers with Ken and propose the plan: 1) go-ahead POC on Dedicated VPC with CMK, 2) run int8 quant + eval, 3) iterate on tokenizer fix and deploy. Ken — ok to proceed?

Ken (Helios): Yes go ahead. Please include the cost sim when you have the finalized perf numbers.

Maya (SE): Will follow up with a short VPC onboarding doc and required IAM policy snippets. :thumbsup:

Priya (Solutions): Email sent with checklist + question set.

Alex (AM): Closing loop — thanks team, tracking this as the Helios POC (deal desk ref: H-1945). I'll update the CRM and we can reconvene after the quant eval. :raised_hands:
